newsitem.title: UGANDA: Uganda shilling falls vs dlr on renewed dlr demand.
newsitem.headline: Uganda shilling falls vs dlr on renewed dlr demand.

text.p: The Ugandan shilling weakened against the dollar on renewed dollar demand, foreign exchange dealers said on Thursday.
They posted the shilling at a commercial mean of 1087.5 versus the dollar from 1070 on Wednesday. Against the pound, the shilling was posted at an unchanged commercial mean of 1735.
"Demand for the dollar has gone up and yet, the supply has gone down," a dealer said. She said a supply of dollars from the former Zaire had dwindled after rebels seized power in May.
